frame_time_p95_ms.rationale: Protect sustained frame pacing while tolerating sub-millisecond capture noise.

frame_time_p99_ms.rationale: Protect tail latency and visible stutter without overfitting one outlier.

input_to_present_proxy_p95_ms.rationale: Guard the software input-to-present proxy; this is not input-to-photon latency.

generated_frame_ssim.rationale: Reject a repeatable generated-frame similarity regression in the fixed capture scene.

average_power_watts.rationale: Protect battery and thermal cost on the fixed-power target.

process_crash_count.rationale: A validation run must not crash the workload, Gamescope, or plugin.

black_frame_count.rationale: Any detected black generated frame is a release blocker.

generated_frame_failure_count.rationale: The fixed validation workload must not report failed generated frames.

thermal_throttle_event_count.rationale: Throttled runs are invalid performance evidence rather than a usable baseline.
